outages.description: A loss of generation at the Randolph Harley Power Plant caused a significant drop in Internet traffic on St. Thomas and St. John.
A NamPower substation fault caused a power outage and a significant drop in Internet traffic across central, coastal and southern Namibia.
Fiber optic cuts on ANTEL's (AS6057) national backbone caused a near-total loss of its HTTP request traffic in eastern Uruguay.
Yandex, Russia's biggest internet company, shut down its data centers in Sasovo, Ryazan, and later in Vladimir after drone strikes damaged both facilities.
